_date: DERIVED, not stored — see game/calendar.ts. Level 1 is Monday 1 March 2027.
_teaching: Two rules, four lots, and nothing you do can cost anybody money. The arc is: here is a violation - here is a thing you can click that is NOT one - here is the second rule - now tell them apart on one lot.
briefing: First day. Bonerville, outer loop. Two articles are live — weeds and fence condition. Nothing else on that street is your business, however it looks.
_cameos: Named residents pinned to addresses rather than rolled. Pablo is on 4400 and Patrick, Savanna and Juniper pass 4404 every time Shift 1 is played, which is what makes them people the player recognises rather than more traffic.
story: Welcome to the Addison Master Community Association. You are the Compliance Inspector. There is one.
You're at 2118 Eyezeta, yes? Good. Short commute.
Your predecessor also lived in the community. We won't be discussing that.
Your street is on the Friday route. We don't consider that a conflict.
Three errors ends your day. Three reprimands ends the arrangement.
Questions are addressed in the binder.

lots._teaching: The unambiguous one. A single weed patch, nothing else on the lot to argue about. This is what a finding looks like.

violations.why: Unbordered weed growth in the front turf, visible from the street.
Unbordered weed growth in the front turf, visible from the street.
Turf well past six inches across the front.

lots._teaching: The first LEAVE IT ALONE. A sound fence is a clickable object and not a finding — being able to click a thing has to stop meaning the thing is wrong.

decoys.why: R-105 is live and this fence is intact — every member present, no lean. A fence is not a finding for being a fence.

lots._teaching: The second rule, made unmissable. A collapsed fence on a lot with no weeds, so the finding cannot be confused with the article they already know.

violations.why: The panel has collapsed entirely — members down between the posts.
The lawn has not been cut in weeks.

lots._teaching: Now discriminate. Two clickable objects, one finding. The fence draws the eye because they just learned it — and it is fine.

violations.why: Unbordered weed growth in the front turf.

decoys.why: Intact. The article covers missing, broken and displaced members — not age or color.

artifact.title: In the binder
artifact.text: The tab dividers are hand-labeled in pen. Not yours. The initials are R.M.
